boundaryFindings.finding: Current child-module schema is titled Supply Chain Atlas and directly requires SCM applicability keys.
Canvas anchor coordinate system is encoded in the application shell rather than registered by a domain contract.
Five execution signals are defined as fixed platform constants, including Physical.
Context Composer dimensions are fixed to operating role, movement, node, jurisdiction, carriage regime, condition and contract.
Transformation heuristics are embedded in the product runtime instead of registered by a domain pack.
No formal Enterprise Operations Core ontology or Domain Extension Contract exists.
The previous generic-engine fixture was still SCM-adjacent; domain neutrality had not been proven with a non-SCM module.

decision: Refactor contracts and registries only; do not alter canonical Supply Chain content.
